gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Model Y Standard has no rear touchscreen at all, only manual second-row air vents and no rear seat heaters, so an add-on rear screen in a Standard has no factory rear seat heaters to control and maybe no rear climate controls either.
standout_why: ChatGPT's answer and its cited Tesla pages (tesla.com/modely, Introducing New Model Y, the Touchscreen manual page) say only that 'some Standard versions do not' have the screen. They do not say that the Standard also has manual rear vents and only front seat heaters. The cited Touchscreen manual page probably already covers the front-screen 'Lock Rear Display' control, so that part adds little. Not a Tesla App (2026-06-05, rank 18, not cited) covers the June 2026 16-inch center screen for every Model Y but does not mention a rear screen.
decides: Trim decides this pick. Premium, Performance and earlier Juniper cars already have Tesla's 8-inch rear screen, which pairs two Bluetooth headphone sets and can be locked from the front. A Standard or a 2020–2024 Model Y needs an add-on. For a Standard, our row for the Hansshow H86 says it has 'rear climate and seat controls'. Remove that claim, or check it against Hansshow's page, because the Standard has no rear seat heaters (InsideEVs) and has manual second-row vents (EVWire). For 2020–2024 cars, the add-on rear screens and the Aurzen projector setup stay in the running.

findings.label: Rear passenger touchscreen
findings.value: None: 'The 8-inch rear passenger touchscreen has been removed'
findings.source_title: InsideEVs, Iulian Dnistran: Tesla Model Y Standard and Model 3 Standard gutted features (2025-10-09)
findings.note: Named reviewer. Tesla's own pages returned 403 to my fetch tool, so I could not check this on the maker's page.

findings.label: Heated seats
findings.value: Front row only ('only the front seats are heated'); no ventilated seats
findings.note: This bears on add-on rear screens that advertise rear seat-heat control on a Standard.

findings.label: Rear screen and second-row vents
findings.value: 'no rear screen'; 'manual second row air vents'
findings.source_title: EVWire, Jaan Juurikas: The 35 things Tesla removed or changed for Model Y Standard & Model 3 Standard trims (2025-10-09)
findings.note: Backs up InsideEVs on the missing rear screen. Says the rear vents are adjusted by hand, not from a screen.

findings.label: Headphone pairing limit
findings.value: Up to 2 sets of Bluetooth headphones
findings.source_title: Tesla Model Y 2025+ Owner's Manual, p. 11 'Rear Touchscreen' (ManualsLib copy)
findings.note: ManualsLib copy of Tesla's manual. tesla.com returned 403. The Rear Touchscreen section has no 'if equipped' note. Its controls cover rear climate on/off, fan and airflow, rear seat heaters, moving the front passenger seat, media, video, gaming and volume. Media and volume changes also affect the front cabin.

findings.label: Front-seat control and lock
findings.value: Rear screen remote app in the front bottom bar; lock via Controls > Display > Lock Rear Display
findings.source_title: Tesla Model Y 2025+ Owner's Manual, p. 11 (ManualsLib copy)
findings.note: The cited Tesla Touchscreen manual page probably states the same thing.

findings.label: Touch lock in the 2026.26 Summer Update
findings.value: Front seat can lock the rear display through the Rear app. Feature is 'Standard across all Tesla vehicles equipped with a dedicated rear passenger touchscreen'
findings.source_title: Not a Tesla App: Tesla 2026.26 Summer Update: What Each Model and Hardware Version Gets (2026-07-30)
findings.note: The article names no model years and no exclusions beyond needing a factory rear screen. Add-on screens are therefore not covered.

findings.label: June 2026 Model Y spec change
findings.value: 'Every Model Y configuration now comes with black headliner + larger 16″ center touchscreen' (including RWD)
findings.source_title: Drive Tesla Canada: Tesla Model Y black headliner and 16-inch screen standard in North America (2026-06-05)
findings.note: Neither this article nor Not a Tesla App's 2026-06-05 report says a rear screen was added to the Standard. So the 16-inch upgrade does not show the Standard has a rear screen.

findings.label: How to tell Juniper from legacy for fitment
findings.value: Juniper has an 8" rear-console touchscreen and legacy Model Y does not. VIN position 10 = S (2025) or T (2026). North American deliveries began January 2025
findings.source_title: Basenor, Daniel Zhang: 2026 Model Y Juniper Accessories Fitment Guide (2026-04-21)
findings.note: This is an accessory retailer's guide. It says the rear console changed from an open cubby to 'Closed with rear display', so legacy rear-console screens (Teslahubs, TESERY, Tlyard) do not carry over to Juniper. It does not separate Juniper Standard from Premium.
